title: Live SSE Reality Stream -- keyframe+delta codec
gate_source: EXP-604 dashboard + EXP-507 streaming -> live observable reality conduit

codec.coarse_channel: keyed by H_coarse; periodic KEYFRAME (I-frame) + thresholded DELTAS (P-frames, only anchors moved > eps)
codec.section_channel: keyed by 507 section signature; first occurrence full leaf telemetry, repeats -> section_ref (client cache)
codec.heartbeat: H_state unchanged -> heartbeat; at EMA equilibrium the stream goes near-silent
codec.bitrate: proportional to RATE OF CHANGE, not world size (mirrors EXP-507 memory bound)
codec.no_pop_in: each leaf's stitched value depends only on coarse+centroids (EXP-507) -> sections render independently, no cross-section dependency, no seams even half-loaded

transport.server: game/observability/sse_server.py (stdlib http.server); serves dashboard at / and SSE at /stream
transport.client: dashboard live client (EventSource) decodes keyframe+delta + section cache; sections pulse in

assertions_fork_A: [2] codec exact: decode(encode(states)) reconstructs the coarse field bit-exactly
[3] keyframe+delta: a coarse_delta carries only changed anchors (< full keyframe size)
[4] content-addressed sections: repeated sections emit section_ref (leaves not re-sent)
[5] heartbeat: an unchanged world emits a heartbeat (near-zero payload)
[6] bitrate proportional to change: equilibrium codec << full-resend
[7] no pop-in: each section event is self-contained (carries all its leaves); render needs only coarse+centroids
[8] keyframe resync: decoding from a keyframe onward reconstructs the coarse field (late subscriber, no drift)
[10] decoupled: game/ has no engine.* import (clean-room guard)
assertions_fork_B: [2] event-type counts fwd == mir (P_yz-invariant stream structure)
[5] section signature set cardinality fwd == mir

exp606_gate.trigger: live stream stable -> WebXR + multi-velocity moving sections; Zeeman-coupled Citadel (EXP-509)
